basic_info.description: Nestled in an established neighborhood, this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of urban living and suburban tranquility. The two spacious bedrooms provide ample room for rest and relaxation. The private backyard provides the perfect outdoor entertaining, while the spacious garage offers ample storage and parking. For those chilly evenings, the cozy fireplace in the living room creates a welcoming ambiance. The property's prime location is a true highlight, situated in a desirable area that offers easy access to the city's vibrant cultural scene, schools, and an array of dining and shopping options. This exceptional home is a great opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's coveted real estate market. 312 Avalon Ave is the perfect haven for those seeking the ultimate in Bay Area living. Schedule a viewing today and discover the endless possibilities that this property has to offer.
